signal: Veriff crossed ~$110M ARR (up 83% YoY), acquired Vespia to verify entities, and was named a Leader in G2's Summer 2026 Identity Verification Grid.

email.body1:
Ann-Christiin, saw Veriff crossed roughly $110M ARR, acquired Vespia to verify entities, and landed as a G2 Summer 2026 Leader.

Growth at that pace usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the ABM and campaign engine can convert, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Veriff off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ann-Christiin, quick follow-up for Veriff.

When campaigns surface demand faster than reps can follow up, in-market accounts go cold before anyone reaches out. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings the program needs to produce to hit target, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings your ABM motion needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ann-Christiin, last bit of proof for Veriff.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Veriff's reply rate likely compares to peer identity-verification firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ann-Christiin, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If converting campaign demand into meetings faster isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Doubling revenue and integrating Vespia makes for a busy stretch, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ABM motion? I will tailor it to Veriff either way.
